data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable prior year loss development of GBP 8.6 million was recorded in 2021 compared to unfavourable development of GBP 7.3 million in the prior calendar year. In the current calendar year, the favourable loss development was driven primarily by lower emergence of claims of certain lines of business than previously anticipated.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Impact of COVID-19 related losses in the prior year contributed to prior year development dynamics (referenced as contributing to movement in prior accident years).

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle, the syndicate recorded a net adverse prior-year movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 20.4m (about 4.10% of opening gross claims outstanding). The report's narrative describes a favourable net prior-year development of GBP 8.6m (driven by lower-than-expected emergence in certain lines and impacted by COVID-19 in the prior year); however the gross claims development table yields a net strengthening when aggregating individual underwriting-year movements. The movement appears driven by a mix of releases on some older years and increases on others (overall net adverse), with COVID-19 and variations in claims emergence cited as contributory factors.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable prior year loss development of GBP 8.6 million was recorded in 2021 compared to unfavourable development of GBP 7.3 million in the prior calendar year.
In the current calendar year, the favourable loss development was driven primarily by lower emergence of claims of certain lines of business than previously anticipated.
this improvement was driven by the favourable impact of loss development relating to prior accident years as well as by the impact of COVID-19 related losses in the prior year

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: narrative text reports a favorable NET prior-year release of GBP 8.6m, but the GROSS claims development table yields a net gross strengthening of c. GBP 20.409m. For this extraction the gross figure is taken from the gross claims development triangle (triangle used because it provides gross movements). Where report narrative provides only net figures they are noted in exact_reserve_text but were not used as the primary numeric (see prior_year_development_gbp_m). No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior-year reserves were identified. Lob-level gross prior-year movements are not explicitly provided by standard Lloyd's LOBs in gross terms, so lob_movements are omitted.
